assignments.name: isShort
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const title = String($('Format mrbonzomusic').item.json.title || ''); const link = String($('Format mrbonzomusic').item.json.link || ''); if (title.toLowerCase().includes('#shorts') || link.includes('/shorts/')) return true; let dur = null; try { const info = $('Video info').item.json || {}; dur = Number(info.durationSeconds || info.duration); } catch (e) { dur = null; } if (Number.isFinite(dur) && dur > 0) return dur <= 60; const h = $json.headers || {}; const loc = String(h.location || h.Location || ''); const url = String($json.url || ''); if (loc.includes('/watch')) return false; if (loc.includes('/shorts/') || url.includes('/shorts/')) return true; return Number($json.statusCode) === 200; })() }}

assignments.name: durationSeconds
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { try { const n = Number(($('Video info').item.json.durationSeconds || $('Video info').item.json.duration)); return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 0; } catch (e) { return 0; } })() }}
